Robotics Dream Keeper ChallengeStage 3 · Launch

Korosuke
コロ助

An on-device interactive animatronic on the D-Robotics RDK X5 — it sees, listens, thinks, talks (JP / EN), and emotes. 100 % on-device, no cloud.

「ワガハイはコロ助ナリ！」
The robot01

A ~46 cm clockwork robot, brought to life on one board

  • Open-source Korosuke (コロ助) from Kiteretsu Daihyakka
  • Brain = RDK X5 — 10 TOPS BPU, 8× Cortex-A55, 8 GB · eyes & arms on an ESP32-S3
  • Perception, speech, LLM, voice, expression — all on the board
  • No cloud, no API keys, no dev-PC at runtime
Architecture · BPU perception / CPU language02

One board owns cognition; the ESP32-S3 drives the body

Sensors
📷 USB camera
🎙 Microphone
✋ Head touch
▶
RDK X5 · 10 TOPS BPU · 8× Cortex-A55
BPU — YOLO11n-pose (person + skeleton) · ~19.5 FPS
CPU — SenseVoice (STT) → TinySwallow (LLM) → Open JTalk / espeak (TTS)
100 % on-device · no cloud · no API keys
▶
Body · ESP32-S3
👁 2× round eye LCDs
💪 rope-pull arms
🔊 I2S speaker (MAX98357A)

The X5 BPU can’t accelerate an LLM — so perception on the BPU, language on the CPU is the correct split.

Voice pipeline · fully on-device03

Mic → understand → reply → speak, with no network

🎙 Mic→VAD→STT · SenseVoice→ LLM · TinySwallow→TTS · JTalk / espeak→🔊

Mirrors D-Robotics’ own RDK voice-interaction reference — SenseVoice ASR + a Qwen2.5-1.5B-family LLM (we run the Japanese-tuned TinySwallow-1.5B).

The differentiator04

日本語 / English / Auto

One switch flips the whole robot — speech recognition, the LLM’s persona & replies, the voice, and the web dashboard — instantly, on-device.

Auto: SenseVoice detects the spoken language and Korosuke answers in kind.

Expressive & alive05

It has a face, a mood, and a wave

  • Eyes — 2× round LCDs, 8 emotions: smile, a “thinking” look, ✕✕ shutdown
  • Arms — rope-pull bellows arms that wave & cheer; auto-detach
  • Touch — pet the head → a happy reaction
  • Character-faithful, pitched “…ナリ” voice
Engineering & polish06

Custom kernel work — and it ships like a product

  • MAX98357A I2S amp — an out-of-tree ALSA driver + device-tree overlay the vendor kernel didn’t ship
  • Power-on auto-greeting · a physical safe-shutdown with a clear “safe to unplug” ✕✕ signal
  • Self-healing audio · static maintenance IP · a web dashboard showing the live AI stack
Two integrations, one pipeline07

A low-latency monolith and a ROS 2 graph

Monolith
korosuke_monitor
low-latency demo + web dashboard — what the video shows
ROS 2 graph
ros2_ws/
6 nodes + custom messages · optional rosbridge web console

Same on-device stack, two deployments.

Honest scope08

What is not in this build

  • ❌ 2-axis mouth / lip-sync — expression is via the eyes + voice
  • ❌ Neck servo — face tracking is eyes-only
  • ✴️ Bipedal “penguin” walking — salvaged QDD motors unreliable (decoupled stretch)
  • ❌ Back-mounted sword prop

We show what actually ships — nothing faked.

Wake → follow → talk (JP↔EN) → gesture → pet → safe shutdown
